title: Chaping Chains
description: Chaping (Shaping) Chains, 8x chains for crafting chains, and craftable chain armor. 1 Datapack
body: Adds recipes for every chainmail armor, octuples (8x) the chainmail crafting recipe so its a lot easier to make the chainmail armor. This is a datapack for 1.21-1.21.4 it should work perfectly fine for those specific versions. Otherwise, don't message me about it.
